BiblicalUsage: Chabeth is a flat cake, a griddle-cake, and it appears once, in the temple duties: Mattithiah the Levite had the set office over the things made in the pans.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God counts the man over the pans among His servants, and no temple duty is too small to be named.
